scripts.check:client-secrets: sh -c 'if rg -n "TRUELAYER_CLIENT_SECRET|TRUELAYER_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY|FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY" js app components lib --glob "!app/api/**"; then echo "Potential secret reference found in client paths." && exit 1; else echo "No client secret references found."; fi'
scripts.vercel-build: npm run sync:legacy && npm run typecheck && next build && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json
